children: is biased to climb above a neutral range of $4,379-$4,440 per ounce.
The range is formed by the 23.6% and the 38.2% retracements of the downtrend from $4,696 to $4,281. A break below $4,379, which looks less likely, would trigger a fall into the $4,281-$4,342 range.
A break above $4,440, which looks more likely as the metal is testing it, could be followed by a surge into the $4,489 to $4,537 range.
On the daily chart, the price move is controlled by a series of retracements on the downtrend to $3,945 from $4,889. The market seems to be stabilizing around $4,417.
The stabilization signals an extension of the bounce toward $4,529 again.
